description: This PHP source file defines the SugarFeedFlush class, which provides a method to flush stale entries from the SugarFeed table based on a date cutoff. It manages settings related to the 'sugarfeed_flushdate' and interacts with database and bean factory classes to perform cleanup operations.

classes.name: SugarFeedFlush
classes.description: Class responsible for flushing stale SugarFeed entries based on the last flush date stored in settings. It ensures outdated entries are deleted from the database to maintain performance.

methods.name: flushStaleEntries
methods.description: Method that retrieves configuration, checks the last flush date, and if necessary, deletes entries older than 14 days from the SugarFeed table, then updates the flush date setting.
